lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's zero? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 0? Nope!

lines.text: Add one, two, four, eight, and keep doubling, up to two to the ninety-ninth.
lines.caption: Add 1, 2, 4, 8, and keep doubling, up to 2⁹⁹.

lines.text: What's the remainder when you divide the sum by seven?
lines.caption: What's the remainder when you divide the sum by 7?

lines.text: Divide by seven: one, two, four, then eight leaves one again. A cycle!
lines.caption: Divide by 7: 1, 2, 4, then 8 leaves 1 again. A cycle!

lines.text: One plus two plus four is seven, so each group of three leaves nothing.
lines.caption: 1 plus 2 plus 4 is 7, so each group of 3 leaves nothing.

lines.text: One hundred terms make thirty-three groups, plus one extra.
lines.caption: 100 terms make 33 groups, plus 1 extra.

lines.text: That extra term, two to the ninety-ninth, leaves one.
lines.caption: That extra term, 2⁹⁹, leaves 1.

lines.text: Zero was the trap. It forgets the last term.
lines.caption: 0 was the trap. It forgets the last term.

lines.text: Did you get one? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 1? Tell me below!
